Nepal markanx quqanak ayrusaw jilayapxi, ukaquqanakastï walja qullqi churaraki. Qhipa maranakanx Edgeworthia gardneri yaqha markanakar aljañax juk’ampiw jilxatawayi, Himalaya uksan quqanakapax Japón markanx sinti munatawa kunalaykutix papil qullqi, pasaporte, suwrinaka, istampillanaka ukat yaqha papilanak/ laphinak imprimiñatakiw aski.
Uka quqax argeli sutinirakiwa, Himalaya tuqinx argeli quqax sayarux 1500-3000 luqawa, quqan thaqhatatapx Sindhupalchok, Dolakha, Taplejung, Ilam, Baglung, Myagdi ukhamarak yaqha markanakanx aljañatakix walwa achuyañ qallanatapxi.
“Argeli quqax nanaktuqinak yaqha markar aljañatakix achuyata” sasinw Lhakpa Sherpax qhanancht’i, jupasti quqanak achuyaraki ukatx Dolakha uksan papil luraraki. “Pä waranq waranqatx jilwa rupias nepalíes qullqi munisipyurux apani (15 405 dólares estadounidenses – ch’uxña qullqi)”.
Quqamp Nepal markachirinakamp Narayan Manandhar jupan panka qillqataparjamax qhanancharakiwa, China markataxay “siglo XIV” ukhax Nepal markar amparamp papil lurañax uñstchispän ukjamwa uñt’ayasi.
